results.title: What Is the Most-Liked Post on Instagram?
excerpts:
# The Story Behind The Most-Liked Instagram Posts of All Time
## **A new Instagram record is set**
Thanks to the hype surrounding 2022’s FIFA World Cup, Lionel Messi has set a new record for the most-liked Instagram post in history, surpassing the previous record held by the egg.

...

The record doesn't just stop there, however – as the Instagram post racked up tens of millions of likes in just a matter of days, it became the most-liked post on any social media platform, overtaking the most-liked video on YouTube, “Despacito” by Luis Fonsi ft.

...

## **Other accounts that have the most-liked posts of all time**
### **Zendaya (@zendaya):**
She has also gained popularity through her much-beloved relationship with fellow actor Tom Holland, whom she worked together with for Marvel’s popular Spider-Man films. One of her posts, in particular, resonated with fans, helping it break into the top 20 most-liked of all time – a post wishing Tom a happy birthday.

### **Tom Holland (tomholland2013):**
Not to be outdone by his popular girlfriend, Tom Holland also has a post that managed to climb its way into the 20th spot of most liked Instagram posts of all time.

...

### **Selena Gomez (@selenagomez):**
As the most-followed woman on Instagram, overtaking Kylie Jenner and others in the Kardashian clan, Selena has no shortage of popular Instagram posts, with her most-liked being a recent selfie with the caption “Violet Chemistry”.

...

### **Ariana Grande (@arianagrande):**
Besides her singing chops, fans have remained invested in Ariana’s high-profile relationships over time; as such, her most popular post was that of a selection of snaps showcasing her wedding to husband Dalton Gomez, garnering over 26 million likes.

# What is the most liked Instagram post? Taylor Swift-Travis Kelce raises question
## 10. XXXTentacion
After rapper XXXTentacion was fatally shot in May 2018, his last -- and only -- Instagram [post](https://www.instagram.com/p/Bi-hISIghYe/) is over 34 million likes.

...

## 7. Lionel Messi
Messi's 2022 World Cup win is a key factor in many of the top-liked posts. This one of him with the trophy on an airplane posted on Dec. 19, 2022, reached 41.2 million.

## 6. Cristiano Ronaldo
Everyone knows about Ronaldo and Messi's on-pitch rivalry. So, when they joined forces for a paid partnership post on Nov. 19, 2022, it drew 41.6 million likes.

results.title: 20 Most Liked Instagram Posts of All Time | Brandwatch
excerpts:
# The 20 Most Liked Posts on Instagram
## 20. Ronaldo honors Pelè
Cristiano Ronaldo opens this list with a tribute to Pelé, one of football's greatest players, following his death in 2022. By writing the caption in Portuguese, Ronaldo connected with audiences across Brazil and his native Portugal. The post has earned 31.3 million likes to date.

...

## 12. XXXTentacion’s last Instagram post
This was the last post from rapper XXXTentacion before his death in June 2018. It’s actually the only picture on his Instagram feed and to date has generated 34.1 million likes.
Eerily, a music video was released posthumously in which the rapper attends his own funeral.
Loading Instagram Post...

...

## 4. Brothers sing “Jeene Laga Hoon”
Another new entry that’s rocketed straight into the top five, this Reel from April 2025 has received over 52 million likes (to date). In the Reel, singer Kishore Mondal is joined by his brother for a captivating rendition of the hit song “Jeene Laga Hoon.”
> [](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DITBVk3z6pJ/)

## 3. Messi really loves the trophy
More Messi? And he’s with the trophy again. This time, it’s a shot of him in bed snuggling with the World Cup Trophy. Sports stars have slept with their trophies and medals before, and Messi gained 53.6 million likes with his caption “Buen día !”
> [](https://www.instagram.com/p/CmYyND_OYMl/)

...

## 1. Lionel Messi celebrates winning the World Cup with Argentina
Messi's done it! He beat the egg! This is a moment that'll go down in history.
The most successful Instagram post in history is a carousel of Messi and Argentina winning the 2022 World Cup. With 74.7 million likes, will it ever be topped?
